title: StatusSnapshotResult
description: What semiont status reports: each knowledge base with its own services, and each service the knowledge bases share, once, with the knowledge bases it serves.

knowledgeBases.description: The target's stack; with no target, the stack of the knowledge base the control server stands in, else every recorded one.

shared.description: The services every knowledge base shares, group by group, and those the machine serves for the knowledge bases that name them.
